scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && vitest run
scripts.test:visual: tsx tests/visual/capture.ts http://localhost:5173/?look=reference tests/visual/output && tsx tests/visual/compare.ts
scripts.test:visual:webgpu: tsx tests/visual/capture.ts http://localhost:5173/?look=reference tests/visual/output/chrome-webgpu --chrome && tsx tests/visual/compare.ts tests/visual/reference tests/visual/output/chrome-webgpu tests/visual/diff/chrome-webgpu
scripts.test:visual:webgl: tsx tests/visual/capture.ts http://localhost:5173/?look=reference tests/visual/output/chrome-webgl --chrome --no-webgpu && tsx tests/visual/compare.ts tests/visual/reference tests/visual/output/chrome-webgl tests/visual/diff/chrome-webgl
